name: spending-ring
title: Spending Ring
description: A monthly spending donut chart you can spin like a dial. Each slice that passes the top marker takes over the centre, showing its name, amount, share and change.
use: A finance dashboard wants a compact category breakdown that people can explore by spinning.
avoid: The ring needs several categories to read; with one or two slices the spin feels pointless and the gaps look odd.
a11y: The ring is a labelled slider with arrow keys and a legend of buttons; the delta relies on colour plus an arrow for meaning. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a multicoloured donut ring with a small dark marker at the top, a large amount and percentage in the middle, and a two-column legend of coloured dots and rounded totals below.
behaves: Dragging around the ring turns it and dims unselected slices while the centre readout swaps to whatever sits under the marker. A flick coasts on a spring and settles, and clicking a legend row turns straight to it.
customise: Title, the category array of amounts, change and colour classes, and the currency are props; ring size, gaps and spring are constants.
weight: light: One SVG ring and a short spring loop that stops once the dial settles.
